title: Initiative Tracking That Drives Engineering Delivery | Faros

hero.headline: Confidence in every commitment
hero.subhead: Faros provides the visibility leaders need to track initiative progress, align teams to priorities, and hit delivery commitments.

sections.heading: The challenge — misalignment costs time, money, trust
sections.body: Improve stakeholder visibility (live dashboards vs spreadsheets), drive critical projects to success, align resources to outcomes.

sections.heading: Our solution
sections.body: Automate reporting with real-time data (single source of truth for quarterly commitments, initiative health/budget/dates); keep critical work on track (forecast timelines, alert on overruns/delays); monitor portfolio investments and capacity allocation across initiatives/products/teams/geographies; automatic work categorization and attribution.

notes: Retrieved via Claude-in-Chrome. Initiative Tracking is a distinct named sub-capability of Predictable Delivery (faros:delivery-excellence). Reinforces the taxonomy flag (PMO/planning surface). De-dupe: propose as sub-capability under delivery-excellence, not a standalone pillar.
